subtests.name: e.style['top'] = "--func()" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(auto)" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(100px)" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(#fff)" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(auto, 100px, #fff)" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(auto ,100px ,#fff)" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(auto , 100px , #fff)" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(auto,100px,#fff)" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(\"thing\")" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(var(--x))" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(var(--x, auto))" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(--bar(), --baz(--fez()))" should set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(!)" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func( !)" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func( ! )" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(! )" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(;)" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(})" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(])" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(url(\\\n))" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(asdf,)" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(,)" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(, )" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func( ,)" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func( , )" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(a,,b)" should not set the property value
e.style['top'] = "--func(a, ,b)" should not set the property value
